_about: Data for tools/rules_lint.py and tools/hooks/rules_guard.py. Budgets and patterns change only here (CODEOWNERS-protected). There is no inline ignore comment and no per-line allow-list; exemptions are by layer. Every tracked markdown file matches a layer or a glob in `unchecked`.

unchecked.reason: vendored third-party skills; their text is not ours to rewrite
per-agent memory notes the harness writes; dated by design and never linked as a rule
the mockup atlas has its own lifecycle and hub; only its README files are a layer
eval cases and their notes are graded data, changed only apart from agent behaviour
measured decision-model output and scenarios; eval data
GitHub's own templates and workflow notes; not loaded by agents as rules
how one tool folder works; tool documentation, not rule text
the product's front page for people

forbidden.home: the PR description or .agents/decisions/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md (why and when); never the rule text
the PR description or .agents/decisions/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md (why and when); never the rule text

forbidden.why: a rule carries no who-decided attribution
forbidden.home: the PR description or .agents/decisions/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md (why and when); never the rule text

forbidden.why: a rule names no PR or issue number
forbidden.home: the PR description or the commit; a rule names no PR, issue or commit
the PR description or the commit; a rule names no PR, issue or commit

forbidden.why: a rule states the present default, not what it replaced
forbidden.home: rewrite the rule in place as the present default and delete the old wording; history stays in git, the PR and .agents/decisions/

homes.narrow exception: the enforcing tool's config or allow-list with a reason; prose never
